title: Ilocos Sur RTC acquits community doc, IP advocate of attempted murder

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY, Philippines — An Ilocos Sur regional trial court has acquitted community doctor Ana Marie Rilloraza-Leung and indigenous rights advocate Alpha Sungay of attempted murder in relation to their supposed ties to the communist rebellion, ruling that prosecutors failed to establish their identities and participation in these supposed crimes.
